r.문화권·종교: Comorian, Arabic and French · Sunni Muslim
r.한국이 파는 것: Nonwovens, rope 38%, Frozen fish 20%, Cars 14%, Other chemicals 7% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Cosmetics, fragrances 88%, Art, antiques 4%, Industrial fabrics 4%, Clothing (woven) 2% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A presidential system that has seen several coups.

t.why: It disputes with France over neighboring Mayotte, which remained French.
t.rel: An Indian Ocean island country that disputes with France over neighboring Mayotte, which remained French. Many residents try to cross to Mayotte, so migration remains an issue. It belongs to both the Arab League and the African Union.
t.know: It produces so much ylang-ylang, a perfume ingredient, that it is called the 'perfumed islands'.
t.etext: An Indian Ocean island country that sells spices such as vanilla and cloves. Remittances from the diaspora are a large part of the economy.
